column1: # One line per opening: ECO code, name, and the moves that reach it in SAN.
# Fields are separated by tabs. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# This is a COMPACT table of main lines, not the full ECO index. Every entry
# here is a well established name for the position it points at; the deeper
# sub-variations are deliberately left out rather than guessed at, because a
# confidently wrong opening name is worse than no name at all.
# Matching is by POSITION, not by move order, so a line reached by transposition
# is named correctly. Add your own lines freely: the file is read at startup and
# the longest match along the game wins.
